methodologyNotes: Roster covers nine high-search smart body-composition scales spanning budget to premium tiers (2017-2023 release window). All nine products independently re-verified against official manufacturer pages (Withings, Renpho, eufy/Anker, Garmin, Fitbit/Google Store, Wyze, Etekcity/VeSync, Amazfit), retailer listings (Amazon, Walmart, Newegg, Best Buy, VeSync), and reputable reviews (Tom's Guide, TechRadar, Live Science, DC Rainmaker, iMore). No products removed: all nine exist and are real models. Corrections this pass: eufy P3 max weight 397->440 lb (180 kg is the body-composition measurement range, not structural capacity, which eufy/Newegg/Walmart all list as 440 lb); Renpho Elis 1 max weight 400->396 lb (official spec for the rechargeable 13-metric Elis 1 is 396 lb/180 kg); Fitbit Aria Air release 2019-12->2019-10 (Fitbit press release: available mid-October 2019); Withings Body Comp source.url fixed to the live shop URL. Prices are published US MSRP or current list price as of 2026-06-15. boolean true = confirmed present, false = confirmed absent, null = not verifiable. Weight capacity in pounds (lbs). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Withings Body Smart

specs.app_ecosystem: Withings Health Mate; works with 100+ apps incl. Apple Health, Google Fit, Fitbit

products.provenance: Price $129.95 confirmed on official Withings US shop page (current MSRP; launched at $99.95 in April 2023 but list price is now $129.95). Weight range 5-200 kg (9-440 lb) confirmed on the official spec page. WiFi 802.11 b/g/n + Bluetooth confirmed. Metric set (weight, body fat %, water %, muscle mass, bone mass, lean mass, visceral fat index, BMR, BMI, standing heart rate ~10) confirmed from withings.com. Release April 2023 confirmed via PR Newswire.

products.name: Withings Body Comp

specs.app_ecosystem: Withings Health Mate; works with 100+ apps incl. Apple Health, Google Fit, Fitbit

products.provenance: Price $229.95 confirmed on official Withings US Body Comp shop page (source URL corrected from /body-comp to /body-comp/black/shop). Metrics include weight, fat %, muscle mass, bone mass, water %, visceral fat, BMI, standing heart rate, vascular age (plus electrodermal activity score). Launch announced Sep 1 2022, on sale Oct 4 2022. Max weight 440 lb and 8-user auto-recognition confirmed.

products.name: Renpho Elis 1

specs.app_ecosystem: Renpho Health app; syncs with Apple Health, Samsung Health, Fitbit

products.provenance: Price $24.99 confirmed citing renpho.com. Max weight CORRECTED 400->396 lb: official spec for the rechargeable 13-metric Elis 1 is 396 lb/180 kg (Amazon listing and Renpho spec); 400 lb is an older marketing round-up. 13 metrics confirmed via BIA. Bluetooth BLE only, no scale-side WiFi, confirmed. Athlete mode confirmed in Renpho Health app. Elis 1 line dates to 2017.

products.name: Eufy Smart Scale P3

specs.app_ecosystem: EufyLife app; syncs with Apple Health, Google Fit, Fitbit

products.provenance: ASIN B0BRBZRTM2; 16 metrics and WiFi (2.4 GHz only) + Bluetooth confirmed from Amazon, Newegg, Walmart, and Tom's Guide. Max weight CORRECTED 397->440 lb: eufy spec / Newegg / Walmart list structural capacity as 440 lb (200 kg); the 180 kg (~397 lb) figure is the body-composition measurement range, not max capacity. Athlete mode (plus pet/pregnancy modes) confirmed. Price $89.99 MSRP confirmed across multiple retailers. Released 2023 (retail availability mid-2023).

products.name: Garmin Index S2

specs.app_ecosystem: Garmin Connect; limited Apple Health integration via third-party sync workarounds

products.provenance: MSRP $149.99 confirmed across Garmin and retailers through 2026. Released October 2020 (Garmin Newsroom press release, DC Rainmaker). Measures 6 metrics: weight, BMI, body fat %, body water %, skeletal muscle mass, bone mass. Up to 16 user profiles confirmed (Garmin manual). WiFi (up to 7 networks) + Bluetooth confirmed. Max weight 400 lb (181.4 kg) confirmed via Garmin manual. Athlete mode present as Activity Class setting.

products.name: Fitbit Aria Air

products.name: Etekcity Smart Fitness Scale ESF24

products.name: Withings BodyFit

releaseSource.quote: Boston, Massachusetts, June 2, 2026 Withings today announced the launch of Withings BodyFit ($279.95), an at-home body composition scale delivering 6-zone segmental analysis via its retractable handle

products.priceNote: Withings' own US store price for the black model, shown in stock with free shipping, the same $279.95 Withings announced at the June 2026 launch

specs.app_ecosystem: Withings app; connects to Apple Health and MyFitnessPal

products.provenance: Read on 2026-10-15: Withings' US store lists the BodyFit in black at $279.95, in stock with an add-to-cart button, and its technical specifications give a weighing range of 5 to 200 kg (9 to 440 lb), Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n plus Bluetooth, automatic recognition of up to 8 users and tailored modes including Athlete; the page's FAQ names Apple Health and MyFitnessPal as connected apps. Withings' June 2, 2026 press release announces the US launch that day and puts the Europe and UK release at July 1, 2026, so the US launch came first. Withings says the scale gives over 40 metrics and its list mixes body measurements with raw sensor signals, steps and weather, so no single metric count is given. T3 reported the launch on June 2, 2026.

products.priceNote: Wyze's own US store price for the black or white model, shown in stock, up from the $79.98 launch price of June 2026

products.provenance: Read on 2026-10-15: Wyze's US store lists the Scale BodyScan in black and white at $84.98, in stock with an add-to-cart button, and its specifications give 17 body composition metrics, an 11 to 400 lb weight range, Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity, automatic recognition of up to 8 users and syncing with Apple Health, Health Connect and Fitbit.
